query.query: Metformin mitochondrial complex I extra-pancreatic effect

results.text: Metformin aggravates pancreatitis by regulating the release of oxidised mitochondrial DNA via the frataxin (FXN)/ninjurin 1 (NINJ1) signalling pathway. Patients with diabetes are at a higher risk of developing acute pancreatitis compared to those without diabetes. Therefore, it is essential to investigate the effects of metformin, a primary treatment for type 2 diabetes, on the progression of pancreatitis.
